metadata.description: Marketplace for the Engineering Flow plugin — an opinionated, superpowers-based engineering workflow kit

plugins.name: engineering-flow
plugins.description: A three-stage engineering pipeline for Claude Code: /feature (security-aware design on your strongest model) → /feature-build (Opus-pinned plan + managed, reviewed execution with nested parallel tracks) → /feature-review (full security & reliability assessment). Includes skill-router nudges, [SEC]/[REL] flagging, build journals with resume, and Haiku-tiered verification.
